column1: # conversion-kicad.md #слои — the non-copper layer table, meant to be edited.
# Copper is NOT here: its numbers come out of the stack formula and nowhere
# else. Everything else is this table, one row per pairing.
# A KiCad name beginning with "F." is PAIRED: the same row also covers the
# bottom side through the sign of the IR number, so "B.SilkS" is -121. A name
# without that prefix is side-less and only matches a positive IR number.
# Several IR layers may land on one KiCad layer (names 125 and values 127 join
# the assembly layer 151 on F.Fab). The reverse direction is decided by ORDER:
# the FIRST row naming a KiCad layer wins it back. Hence 151 before 125/127.
# An IR layer absent from this table is dropped with its number named in the
# log — to carry one more, add a row.
# 135 is Eagle's tGlue and KiCad's F.Adhes: the same thing under two names,
# and KiCad declares that layer on every board anyway. 157 is Eagle's tCAD —
# the component's mechanical body outline, which is what F.Fab is FOR (KiCad's
# own libraries draw the body there), so it joins 151/125/127 rather than
# landing on a comments layer. Both are paired: 36 bGlue and 58 bCAD ride the
# same rows through the sign.
# Still absent on purpose, for want of an obvious home — add a row if you
# want them: 137 tTest, 250 Notes, 299 Contour.
